raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since 2026-01-15 the v2 collector emits txn_ts in UTC while legacy emits America/Chicago local time, and silver treats both as the same clock. v2 rows after 18:00 Chicago time (00:00 UTC) therefore get the next day's date and show up as 00:00-06:00 'off-hours' transactions. That also explains the 31-row day on 2026-01-19. Converting v2 timestamps to Chicago local time (UTC-6, all data is in January/CST) restores a consistent clock and correct txn_date.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.88, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH n AS (SELECT *, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS local_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, local_ts AS txn_ts, CAST(local_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM n;"}}
